argv:
mount -t tmpfs -o mode=755 tmpfs /run
mkdir -p /dev/shm
mount -t tmpfs -o size=64m,mode=1777 tmpfs /dev/shm
/usr/sbin/dockerd >/root/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
for n in $(seq 1 100); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep .1; done
test "$(docker info --format '{{.DefaultRuntime}} {{.Driver}}')" = 'runc overlay2'
docker import /acceptance/container.tar trames-acceptance:local
docker run -d --name web -p 53655:8080 trames-acceptance:local /bin/sh -ec 'printf "named-network-docker\n" >/www/index.html; exec /bin/httpd -f -p 8080 -h /www'
for n in $(seq 1 100); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:53655/ && exit 0; sleep .1; done
exit 1
